items.title: Cosimo Matassa Interview, 1994-01-15
items.q: he would go out and promote records for me

ctx.x: Uh, give, cash, uh, what amounts?

Well, let's say, let's, let's put it this way. I bought a, I bought a, a Cadillac convertible. Uh, got a credit card. Gave it to this guy, paying him, I don't know, in those days, I think I was paying him 400 a week, 500 a week was pretty damn good money. Who was this gentleman? Uh, Bob Robin.
